scope: application-level bounded wake and claim primitive

contract.failure: callback only; retry waits for lease expiry and a later wake
contract.shutdown: close waits for in-flight executors and rejects later wake calls

limitations: The primitive is not wired into Runtime Worker production composition.
It does not choose authorization, owner identity, cancellation policy or executor implementation.
Executor failure is not auto-replayed; durable recovery remains lease-expiry based.
No installed desktop UI or real provider behavior is claimed.
